question: what is the roi in snap-on if the investment was made at the end of 2005 and sold at the end of 2007?
reasoning: We need ROI from end of 2005 to end of 2007. Need stock price at end of 2005 and end of 2007, and dividends. From document: fiscal year-end per share price: 2005 $37.56, 2007 $48.13. Dividends paid per share: 2006 $1.08, 2007 $1.11. Total dividends = $2.19. ROI = (48.13 + 2.19 - 37.56)/37.56 = (50.32 - 37.56)/37.56 = 12.76/37.56 = 0.3397 = 33.97%. But question says "investment was made at the end of 2005 and sold at the end of 2007" - so include dividends. Answer as percentage? Probably 33.97%.
